description: Answers 'what were this company's fundamentals as known on this date - before later restatements?' Give a symbol and as_of (defaults to today). Returns SEC fundamentals as filed (earnings yield, book-to-market, ROE, leverage and more) exactly as known on that date. Covers US stocks with fundamentals from 2011. Free keys get the last 12 months; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_fundamentals_pit
title: Get fundamentals (point-in-time)
